'''Ezak''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] who studied to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on<ref name="TCSWE Wolf" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> An orphan, he knew a great deal about the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who raised him.<ref name="TCSWE" /> Alongside [[Kiri]], [[Lina Lascol]], [[Lartan]], and [[Mox Freedan]], Ezak joined [[Wolf Clan]],<ref name="TCSWE Wolf" /> one of several [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Jedi clans]] that [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|young Jedi]] were placed in when they commenced their Jedi [[Jedi training/Legends|training]]<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> as [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]].<ref name="TCSWE Wolf" /> Ezak was an honorable student, was skilled with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and had a propensity for repairing things due to his interest in technology.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ezak was mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]]. He was the only member of Wolf Clan to receive his own entry.<ref name="TCSWE Wolf" />
